# GET /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/teams

List teams that have access to the repository (org repos only)

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-329`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**200** — []Team

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | int64 | Team ID |
| `name` | string | Team name |
| `description` | string | Team description |
| `permission` | string | Access level |
| `units` | []string | Unit names |
| `units_map` | map[string]string | Units with permissions |

- **404** — Repository not found
- **405** — Repository is not owned by an organization
